components.name: AiAgentTimeline
components.title: Agent Timeline
components.description: Rich timeline visualization with duration, connectors, and nested children.
components.code:
const entries: AiTimelineEntry[] = [
  { id: '1', type: 'thought', content: 'Planning retrieval…', status: 'completed', duration: 120 },
  {
    id: '2',
    type: 'action',
    content: 'Searching knowledge base',
    tool: 'search',
    status: 'completed',
    duration: 850,
    children: [
      { id: '2a', type: 'observation', content: 'Retrieved 12 chunks', status: 'completed' },
    ],
  },
  { id: '3', type: 'action', content: 'Generating response', tool: 'generate', status: 'running' },
]

<AiAgentTimeline :entries="entries" title="Agent Run" :show-duration="true" />

components.name: AiSandbox
components.title: Sandbox

props.name: template
props.description: Custom iframe HTML; use {{code}} as placeholder

props.name: autoRun
props.description: Emit run on mount (refreshes JS iframe)

components.code:
<AiSandbox
  :code="snippet"
  language="javascript"
  title="Model picker"
  :auto-run="true"
>
  <template #header="{ title, run, isRunning }">
  </template>
  <template #editor="{ code, language }">
  </template>
  <template #output="{ iframeHtml, frameVersion, error }">
  </template>
</AiSandbox>
